experiments.paper_section: Mean/std and paired comparison

experiments.paper_section: PictOBI conventional association adapter
experiments.protocol: Training uses source-bearing train/val photo tasks; evaluate held-out characters; frozen encoder shared exactly.

experiments.paper_section: Pre-exploration structural trajectory clusters
experiments.protocol: Seven explicit geometry observables; annotated stroke counts preferred; skeleton segment fallback identified; missing eras retained.

experiments.paper_section: Visual saliency / equal-ink occlusion
experiments.protocol: Recompute geometry features after finite patch occlusion; high/low perturbations remove equal ink pixels.

experiments.paper_section: Computational efficiency
experiments.protocol: Synchronized timed encoder/flow inference, actual parameters and GPU peak memory.

experiments.paper_section: Manifold neighborhoods / trajectory visualization
experiments.protocol: PCA or t-SNE on actual exported coordinates with source-occurrence IDs.

experiments.paper_section: Baseline comparison and statistical significance
experiments.protocol: Query-level paired exact McNemar and optional t-test; does not substitute for seed-level tests.
